name: Text to Audio
description: Converts text files to speech with the Venice AI audio API and writes the files into a folder you choose. Optionally imports the generated audio into the Cove library.
author: yourcove

settings.name: openaiApiKey
settings.description: Venice API key. Falls back to VENICE_API_KEY, then OPENAI_API_KEY, when empty.

settings.name: openaiUrl
settings.description: API base URL. Default is https://api.venice.ai/api/v1. You can also paste a compatible /v1 root or the full /audio/speech path.

settings.name: inputFolder
settings.description: Folder of text files to convert. Searched recursively for .txt and .md files.

settings.name: outputFolder
settings.description: Folder where generated audio files are written. Add this path as a Cove library folder if you want scans to pick them up too.

settings.name: voice
settings.description: Voice ID for the selected model. Default is af_sky (Kokoro).

settings.name: model
settings.description: Venice speech model. Default is tts-kokoro.

settings.name: format
settings.description: Output format written to the output folder. Default is mp3. Other options: opus, aac, flac, wav.

settings.name: importIntoLibrary
settings.description: When enabled, each generated audio file is imported as a Cove audio item after it is written.

settings.name: skipExisting
settings.description: When enabled, files that already have a matching audio file in the output folder are skipped.
